exact_theorem.hamming_extrema: finite completion enumeration attains each directional minimum and maximum
exact_theorem.interval_soundness: an enclosure wholly outside 0.9 and 1.1 implies its finite class
exact_theorem.normalizer_invariance: the same positive normalizer cancels from a right/left source ratio
exact_theorem.prefix_nesting: least-squares feasibility is nested as the ordered prefix grows
exact_theorem.window_construction: each ladder is an ordered contiguous 17-subwindow of the declared pool

protocol.completion_rule: flip at most r binary labels on each native exclusive holdout
protocol.fit_lock: same TPC-308 union rows, labels, and physical source
protocol.ladder_rule: three contiguous 17-cutoff windows in the 19-prime pool
protocol.primary_budget_rule: recompute source-budget ratio per profile ladder
protocol.ratio_rule: right envelope holdout MSE / left envelope holdout MSE
protocol.secondary_budget_rule: freeze TPC-308 budget class for isolation
protocol.strict_classification: right lower iff upper ratio<0.9; left lower iff lower ratio>1.1
